# Lenny's Podcast: Brian Chesky on Airbnb's Growth

Guest: Brian Chesky
Date: 2023-11-15
URL: https://example.com/brian-chesky

## Transcript

Lenny: Welcome to the podcast, Brian. How did Airbnb manage to grow so quickly in the early days?

Brian: Thanks Lenny. In the early days, we really focused on doing things that don't scale. We actually flew to New York to meet our hosts, take professional photos of their apartments, and understand their pain points. That hands-on approach helped us build trust and a community.

Lenny: That's fascinating. What about product-market fit? How did you know you had it?

Brian: We knew we had product-market fit when the retention started compounding and word-of-mouth growth took over. When people came back to book again without us spending on ads, that was the signal. Also, the infamous Obama O's cereal boxes helped us fund the company during the 2008 downturn. We sold them for $40 a box and raised $30,000!

Lenny: Incredible. Any advice for early-stage founders?

Brian: Focus on user love. It's better to have 100 people who love your product than 1,000 who just kind of like it. If they love it, they will tell everyone they know.
